name: SANICHI
recent: SANICHI 于 2026 年 8 月 28 日召开第 21 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会，所有议案均获通过，包括削减资本特别决议。10 月至 11 月期间，两名董事 Yong Ket Inn 与 Lee Yoon Seong 的董事会及委员会职务出现变动。近期没有新闻报导。
notable: 特别股东大会通过削减资本特别决议。
第 21 届常年股东大会所有议案获通过，包括董事费、董事重选及核数师续聘。
董事 Yong Ket Inn 与 Lee Yoon Seong 的董事会及委员会职务出现变动。

recent_en: SANICHI held its 21st AGM and an EGM on 28 August 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including a special resolution for capital reduction. Between October and November, there were board and committee changes involving directors Yong Ket Inn and Lee Yoon Seong. There was no recent news coverage.
notable_en: An EGM passed a special resolution for capital reduction.
All resolutions at the 21st AGM were passed, including directors' fees, re-election of directors and re-appointment of auditors.
There were changes in the board and committee roles of directors Yong Ket Inn and Lee Yoon Seong.
